n_plus_one_workflow_lookup.finding: The list path must use WorkflowRepository.load_by_approval_ids() once for the returned page and must not call load_by_approval_id() in a per-record loop.
n_plus_one_workflow_lookup.fix: ApprovalService.list_approval_page() batches workflow preload after the approval page has been selected.

permission_resolution.finding: Employee visibility previously depended on a wide approval scan followed by per-record visibility checks. Permission keys were cached, but pagination still happened after filtering.
permission_resolution.fix: The service resolves effective permission keys once, derives module tokens once, pushes category/module constraints into the approval query, and applies only a non-DB exact safety check to returned records.

wide_default_pull.finding: The repository implemented pagination as SQL limit = limit + offset followed by Python slicing, and employee/category paths used a fixed scan of 500 records.
wide_default_pull.fix: ApprovalRepository.query_records() now uses SQL OFFSET/LIMIT directly. The 500-record scan path was removed.

blocking_read.finding: A synchronous DB read could occupy the request path until the database returned or timed out.
blocking_read.fix: The route executes the live list read in an isolated read session via a bounded executor and returns degraded data after 2 seconds.
